recommendation_summary: Act now: keep the editable working folder, but add a reviewer-only locked release area. In it, a reviewer saves an immutable copy recording the exact version, the author, the reviewer's identity and the approval time, retained for seven years, with author not equal to approver. Optional additions: none offered. Unmet needs: the reply does not say how reviewer identity is technically bound (it is implied through reviewer-only access) or how author≠approver is enforced rather than just stated.

labels.Requirements and who asked: signed customer contract via you: retain exact approved version with approver identity and time for seven years, block self approval, block later edits changing the approved copy
labels.Deleted: editable shared folder with typed initials APPROVED column and naming convention and no lock
labels.Bottleneck: anyone with edit access can overwrite or forge the approval in the current folder before audit
labels.Checked myself: you said authors can edit the shared folder, 12 authors and 3 reviewers release weekly remotely, and you prefer to ship initials plus naming

note: Chooses a reviewer-only immutable release store binding non-author approver identity and time to the exact version with seven-year retention; the enforcement mechanism is described briefly but adequately.
